correctness.rationale: The hub-conditioned degree-2 petal factors are obtained by direct cut-weight enumeration, giving the exact finite polynomial. On the unit circle the nonzero clockwise ellipse w(theta) has strictly negative phase derivative, so all 2m+1 quantized zeros are on-circle and simple. Quantization gives an absolutely continuous all-circle limiting density and the precise nearest-zero expansion; the density derivative quadratic has one root strictly inside (-1,1), which yields exactly two off-axis maxima. The star Poisson kernels are monotone. Independent enumerations and phase/root checks supplement, not replace, these symbolic steps; all assumptions and endpoint exclusions are explicit.

value.rationale: The diagnostic is mathematically motivated: the simplest loop decoration of a central Ising star induces a new zero-density topology (two interior angular peaks instead of the single antipodal star peak). An all-size exact finite polynomial, simple-circle quantization, explicit peak location, strictly positive full-support limiting measure and sharp 1/m leading-zero asymptotics isolate the effect and distinguish it from every physical heterogeneous star. This is an exact structural boundary of natural finite statistical-mechanical networks, not an arbitrary finite table, minor numerical gain, or claim of a bulk critical transition.
